\item \textit{Notes:} AGI in-, out-, and net-migration rates as a percentage of each county's base filing population, averaged over the indicated pre and post periods (2020 dropped). N counts donor counties per pool. The all-donor pool comprises all U.S.\ counties in each dataset except Alaska, Hawaii, California, Washington, and non-Multnomah Oregon; see Appendix~\ref{sec:appendixb} for the other pools. Panel~A uses all IRS counties (2016--2022); Panels~B--D restrict to the balanced ACS panel (IRS-389, ACS-25+, and ACS-college specifications), for which 337 of the 389 ACS-identified counties (336 donors $+$ Multnomah) survive our balanced-panel and state-drop restrictions. Panel~D restricts to households with at least one college-educated member.
\item Source: IRS SOI county-to-county migration flows (Panels~A and~B); ACS microdata, all 25+ subsample (Panel~C); ACS microdata, college-educated subsample (Panel~D).
